# E132 -- Akera

## Metadata
- **Brand**: Akera Skin and Hair Clinic
- **Industry**: Skincare / Haircare / Health & Beauty
- **Document**: Brand Identity Guidelines
- **Year**: 2023 (October 31, 2023)
- **Pages**: 29
- **Designer/Agency**: Studio Fable

## Brand Strategy
- **Positioning**: Skin and hair clinic brand rooted in science (alpha keratin) but expressed through soft, approachable, gender-neutral visual language.
- **Palette rationale**: "Blue represents calmness and reliability, green embodies natural vitality and growth, while pink signifies gentle care and self-renewal. This gender-neutral palette reflects inclusivity and our commitment to quality & authenticity."
- **Brand essence**: Connection to the fundamental biology of skin and hair -- alpha keratin as the conceptual anchor.

## Logo
- **Primary wordmark**: "akera" in lowercase custom sans-serif with a distinctive wave/tilde symbol (~) appended, forming "akera~". The wave represents alpha keratin protein structure.
- **Descriptor**: "SKIN AND HAIR CLINIC" in spaced uppercase beneath the wordmark.
- **Brand symbol / Monogram**: Standalone "a~" mark -- the letter "a" connected to the keratin wave motif. Used as icon, favicon, and standalone brand mark.
- **Logo rationale** (section 1.3): "The logo unit has been thoughtfully crafted to embody the brand's essence, rooted in the fundamental building blocks of skin and hair -- alpha keratin. The visual element shows this essential component with a simple, minimal, and thoughtful design that could also be perceived as a visual representation of flow or a process."
- **Colorways**: Black on white, black on Fresh Green, white on City Sky (blue), white on Blush Pink. Logo shown across all brand colours.

## Typography
- **Primary font**: Referenced in TOC (pages 13-15) -- not directly sampled. Observable display type is a bold geometric/grotesque sans-serif (used for "Brand Identity Guidelines" on cover and section headers).
- **Secondary font**: Referenced in TOC -- not directly sampled.
- **Body text**: Clean, modern sans-serif with comfortable line spacing.

## Color
- **Core palette** (3 colours + black + white):
  - **City Sky** (blue): #9bc8ff / CMYK 35 13 00 00 / RGB 155 200 255
  - **Fresh Green** (lime): #cdff95 / CMYK 21 00 55 00 / RGB 205 255 149
  - **Pale Pink**: #ffedee / CMYK 00 07 02 00 / RGB 255 237 238
  - **Blush Pink**: #ffd5d1 / CMYK 00 20 11 00 / RGB 255 213 209
  - Black (#000000) and a dark navy/black block also visible in palette grid.
- **Extended palette** (lighter tints for each colour):
  - City Sky light: #b8dcff, lightest: #def0ff
  - Fresh Green light: #dcffae, lightest: #f0ffd9
  - Blush Pink light: #ffe2e1, lightest: #ffedee
- **Palette philosophy**: Gender-neutral, inclusive, purposefully chosen to resonate within the skincare and haircare category. Creates a "harmonious visual identity."

## Graphics
- **Keratin wave motif**: The tilde/wave (~) from the logo doubles as a standalone graphic element, appearing across brand touchpoints.
- **Colour blocking**: Bold use of the three primary colours in large blocks -- split compositions (green + blue on cover), grid-based colour applications.
- **Logo placement**: Symbol shown at multiple scales, from small icon to large environmental graphic.

## Photography
- **Style**: Close-up, high-quality skin/face photography. Warm, natural skin tones. Intimate, clinical yet approachable.
- **Note on mockups**: "Please note that these brand mockups are for sampling only, not for commercial use, as the images are not open source."
- **Subjects**: Diverse skin tones, close-up facial details emphasizing skin quality and texture.

## Applications
- **Scope** (pages 16-28): Social Media, Extended Communication, Collaterals -- substantial applications section covering over 40% of the document.
- Not directly sampled in detail.

## Tone of Voice
- Not covered in a dedicated section. The document is visual-identity focused rather than verbal-identity focused.

## Outliers
- The keratin wave motif (~) is a clever conceptual device that directly ties the visual identity to the science of the brand's core service (skin and hair = alpha keratin).
- Unusually vibrant and playful colour palette for a skin clinic -- lime green, periwinkle blue, and pink feel more like a contemporary DTC brand than a traditional clinical aesthetic.
- Studio Fable credited prominently on every page (top-right header), suggesting this may also serve as a portfolio piece.
- Gender-neutral palette philosophy explicitly called out -- progressive positioning for the beauty/clinic sector.
- Large applications section (13 pages out of 29) suggests strong emphasis on practical implementation.

## Quality Score
- **3/5** -- Well-crafted visual identity with a strong conceptual foundation (keratin wave motif). Vibrant, contemporary colour palette with full spec values. Clean, modern layout. However, the document is relatively compact at 29 pages and lacks brand strategy depth (no mission, values, or tone of voice sections). Typography section not sampled but appears brief (3 pages). The mockup disclaimer suggests some placeholder content. Solid execution for a boutique clinic brand.
